// REQ: LANG-821 LANG-822 LANG-823 LANG-824 /* Find friends of friends. */ MATCH (p:Person {name: $name})-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(fof) WHERE fof <> p AND NOT (p)-[:KNOWS]->(fof) AND fof.age > 30 WITH fof, count(*) AS common ORDER BY common DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN fof.name AS name, common, toUpper(fof.city) AS city, `odd name`; CREATE (n:Person {name: 'Ann', active: true, score: 1.5}) MERGE (n)-[:LIVES_IN]->(:City {name: "Kraków"}) RETURN n IS NOT NULL;
